description.value: Peaked Pies is a family-run Australian bakery café that has operated since 2013, serving handmade savoury and sweet pies, artisan coffee, and Australian-style desserts across locations in Vancouver, Burnaby, and Whistler. The Denman Street location sits at the gateway to the Stanley Park seawall cycling routes, making it a natural stop for cyclists exploring Vancouver's waterfront. The signature 'peaked' pie — a meat pie topped with mashed potatoes, mushy peas, and gravy — is a hearty, portable meal well-suited to refuelling after a long ride.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 59m; stands (3 spaces, covered) at 60m; stands (3 spaces, covered) at 60m; stands (6 spaces, covered) at 84m. Total: 18 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the 975 Denman Street Vancouver location of a multi-location Australian bakery café, with phone 778 379 5612 matching OSM. Delivery via Uber Eats/DoorDash and the fast-food format provide positive evidence for takeout; the menu page references 'veggie options' and a blog post titled 'Calling All Vegans…' confirms vegetarian/vegan offerings. Bike parking, washrooms, water refill, and Wi-Fi are not mentioned anywhere in the website content, so these remain null despite OSM tags for internet_access and wheelchair.
concerns: OSM cuisine tag is 'coffee_shop' but the business is primarily an Australian pie bakery; the tag understates the food offering.

The business has four locations (Denman St Vancouver, West Broadway Vancouver, Burnaby Heights, Whistler); this record covers only the Denman Street location. Separate OSM nodes may or may not exist for the other locations.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-reviewed food business on Denman Street — a primary cyclist corridor to Stanley Park and the seawall — offering hearty, portable food and artisan coffee well-suited to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website mentions 'parking available at rear' for the Denman Street location, which may indicate a rear laneway area that could also accommodate bike parking, but no explicit bike parking language is used.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page states 'traditional meat and veggie options available'; blog post titled 'Calling All Vegans…' indicates vegan offerings
